escalations.reason: Accrual amount mismatch and rebate rate discrepancy. Buyer requests 48,000 minor based on claimed 8,000 units and 6% rate, but shipment ledger shows VL-A holds only 1,200 units for this period, and agreement AG-A specifies 400 bp (4%) not 6%. Correct accrual would be 1,200 × 100 × 4% = 4,800 minor. Buyer message cites expected future volume which is not valid evidence per policy.
